messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — P1: High tail latency observed for inference-api (us-east-1). 30m rolling p95 > 3s, increased error rate on model-v2 endpoints. Bridge: https://meet.redwood/incident/2145009876 :rotating_light:
alex: acked. I'm on the bridge. seeing a spike in KV cache misses and repeated redis evictions. throttling incoming concurrent requests to 50% for now. will scale pool if needed.
maria: @alex thanks. can you dump evictions and mem usage to the thread? also enable fallback to model-v1 for 5% of traffic as a canary.
alex: pulling logs now. snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T09:12:04Z] kv_cache: evict key=ctx_8f2f size=24MB reason=LRU
[2026-03-15T09:12:06Z] kv_cache: miss key=ctx_4a9c latency=12ms
[2026-03-15T09:12:07Z] runtime: request_id=abc123 stage=decode tokens=1024 time_ms=2500
```
jonathan: digging into runtime. looks like a hot-prefix pattern causing huge KV growth for a subset of long conversations -> cache churn. autoscaler didn't spin up because observed CPU was low (GPU memory bound). opening a quick patch to increase KV tombstone TTL and reduce retention for contexts >4k tokens.
alex: scaled pool +1 g4dn instance; rolling fallback: 5% -> 20% now for model-v1. latency down a bit.
priya: support: two paying customers reported slow responses in the past hour (AcmeCorp and Nimbly). Acme saw 4 customer-facing errors, Nimbly had timeouts on long chat flows. I'm drafting customer comms, will share in #support-updates.
tanaka: thanks. can we get an interim status line for customers: degraded performance, mitigation in progress, postmortem scheduled? I'll hold until we confirm stabilization.
alex: marking stabilization at 09:35 UTC — p95 back to ~1.1s after fallback + scale. error rate trending down. will continue monitoring 30m.
maria: handing off to @jonathan for follow-ups and postmortem. alex, please drop any configs you changed and the exact time of handoff.
alex: handoff -> jonathan at 09:40 UTC. changes: autoscaler bump (min_replicas +1), KV TTL tweak (context_retention_ms: 300000 -> 60000), routing rule temp: traffic_split model-v1=20% model-v2=80%.
jonathan: got it. I'll own the post-incident review. proposed timeline: postmortem doc + initial timeline by EOD tomorrow, full blameless postmortem next Wed 10am PT. is that okay?
priya: that works for GTM/comms. requesting an action item to list impacted customers and timeline of degraded calls. assigning to me.
maria: putting together monitoring action items: 1) add 'kv_cache_eviction_rate' as an SLI and alert if 5m rate > 100 evictions/min, 2) add a dedupe layer to pager for repeated eviction flaps in a 15m window, 3) add a synthetic long-chat flow SLO check, 4) update autoscaler to consider GPU memory pressure metric.
samir: will create the tickets. Proposed labels: incidents/KV-churn, infra/autoscaler, observability/alerts. assigning owners: samir->observability, jonathan->runtime, alex->oncall-runbooks, maria->pager-rules.
tanaka: can we also add a runbook step for immediate fallback routing in the playbook? currently it's manual. add `playbook: fallback_to_compatible_model()` with command snippet:
```
# fallback routing example
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood/v1/route/update -d '{"service":"inference-api","traffic_split":{"model-v1":0.2,"model-v2":0.8}}'
```
jonathan: will schedule a follow-up PR to make fallback an automated policy (A/B rollback on p95 > 2s). also will add metric exporter for GPU memory usage to the autoscaler dashboard.
maria: alert tuning notes: current pager fires on p95 > 2s for 5m. we'll refine to only fire if p95 > 2s AND eviction_rate > threshold OR error_rate > 0.5% to reduce noisy pages. will implement dedupe and suppression for same-issue repeats.
alex: quick question — what should we set the SLO target for long-chat flows? right now overall request SLO is 99.5 p95 < 1s but long flows naturally higher.
priya: propose creating a separate SLO for long-chat (>=2048 tokens): 99% p95 < 2.5s. capture in postmortem so customers understand tradeoffs.
samir: tickets created: INC-4217 (KV cache churn root cause), OBS-3380 (kv_eviction_rate alert + dashboard), INF-2890 (autoscaler memory metric + policy), RUN-905 (playbook fallback automation). linking them to postmortem doc.
jonathan: draft postmortem link: https://doc.redwood/postmortems/2145009876-kv-churn. I'll drop a timeline and RCA section by EOD.
tanaka: I'll draft the customer-facing note and ping @pri a for review. action: announce stabilization, planned postmortem, and ETA for customer comms.
maria: final followups: 1) convert temporary routing change back to original once we test autoscaler and TTL changes (owner: alex), 2) add long-chat synthetic to alerting (owner: samir), 3) update oncall runbook with KV eviction troubleshooting steps (owner: alex). target completion: two weeks.
alex: acknowledged. I'll revert traffic split once autoscaler changes land and we see 24h stable.
incident-bot: Incident 2145009876 moved to status: stabilized -> monitoring (auto-update).
jonathan: thanks everyone. saving notes to the postmortem doc now. we'll keep this thread as the timeline for related follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
